study.title: Pre-Registered Confirmatory Study for Hypotheses H1-H6
study.objective: Evaluate six fixed crypto strategy families with frozen candidate grids under walk-forward optimization and a single locked holdout read.

amendment.scope: Clarifies PnL accounting, undefined Sharpe handling, and q95 interpolation.

pnl_model.name: synthetic_constant_1x
pnl_model.position_timing: p is known at the bar open

walk_forward.candidate_policy: each pre-registered fixed candidate is scored on stitched out-of-sample results only

formula_metadata.sharpe_definition: SR* is the observed per-bar nonannualized out-of-sample Sharpe ratio for a stitched candidate path.
formula_metadata.dsr_formula: DSR = Phi(((SR* - SR0) * sqrt(T - 1)) / sqrt(1 - sample_skew * SR* + ((pearson_kurtosis - 1) / 4) * SR*^2))
formula_metadata.benchmark_formula: SR0 = sigma_SR * ((1 - gamma) * Phi^-1(1 - 1/N) + gamma * Phi^-1(1 - exp(-1) / N))
formula_metadata.sample_size_symbol: T is the stitched out-of-sample bar count used to estimate SR*.

distribution_moments.sample_skew: sample skewness of stitched out-of-sample bar returns
distribution_moments.pearson_kurtosis: sample Pearson kurtosis of stitched out-of-sample bar returns with normal benchmark equal to 3

formula_metadata.cross_sectional_dispersion: sigma_SR is the sample standard deviation across the 186 observed candidate Sharpe ratios.
failure_conditions: candidate is not evaluated for DSR when observed stitched out-of-sample Sharpe <= 0
candidate fails when the DSR denominator is non-finite or non-positive

permutation_test.method: signal-path circular shifts within each fold
permutation_test.null_summary: best-of-all-candidates null Sharpe across the full frozen family for each permutation draw

pass_rules: candidate beats cost-matched buy-and-hold total return
permutation observed Sharpe strictly above q95

hypotheses.name: Volume Shock Mean Reversion
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Capitulation-style down moves on abnormal volume may overshoot and mean revert over short horizons.

signal_definition.return_condition: current-bar return z-score over the prior 20-bar baseline < -2
signal_definition.baseline_rule: all rolling baselines are causal and exclude the current bar

hypotheses.name: Realized-Volatility Compression Donchian Breakout
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Breakouts from realized-volatility compression regimes may persist once price escapes a 20-bar channel.

signal_definition.filter_rule: realized volatility over 20 bars is below the prior rolling-year lower tercile
signal_definition.baseline_rule: the rolling-year tercile is computed causally and excludes the current bar

trade_construction.entry_timing: first executable bar after breakout confirmation

hypotheses.name: Session Boundary Drift
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Systematic order-flow transitions around major session boundaries may induce directional drift from one session open to the matching session close.

signal_definition.timing_rule: enter at each session bar open inside the named window and exit at the immediately following session-end open

hypotheses.name: Run-Length Continuation Or Reversal
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Consecutive same-sign returns can indicate either momentum continuation or exhaustion reversal, depending on regime.

signal_definition.pattern_rule: exactly N consecutive same-sign returns before signal generation
signal_definition.direction_rule: each candidate trades both signs: continuation goes long after up-streaks and short after down-streaks, while reversal inverts that mapping

hypotheses.name: NR7 Delayed Breakout Confirmation
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Narrow-range compression can precede expansion, but requiring next-bar close confirmation reduces false triggers.

signal_definition.confirmation_rule: the immediately next bar closes beyond the NR7 high or low
signal_definition.execution_rule: signal is stamped at that confirmation close and fills on the following open

hypotheses.name: Low-Entropy Realized-Volatility Compression Donchian Breakout
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Breakouts may be strongest when realized-volatility compression is paired with unusually concentrated volume states, indicating latent imbalance before expansion.

signal_definition.filter_rule_primary: realized volatility over 20 bars is below the prior rolling-year lower tercile
signal_definition.filter_rule_secondary: normalized Shannon volume entropy20 is below its prior rolling-year median
signal_definition.baseline_rule: rolling-year tercile and median baselines are causal and exclude the current bar
